definition: A software platform that allows users to build, train, or deploy AI models and applications through visual interfaces rather than writing code directly.
details: No-code AI platforms lower the barrier to building AI-powered applications, enabling domain experts without deep programming or ML expertise to prototype and deploy models or workflows.
story: Imagine teaching a friend to shoot a basketball. They miss, and you walk them backwards through the shot — elbow, wrist, release — to find what needs fixing. It is the same loop you use to learn anything: try, miss, correct, try again. Underneath all the magic is a patient process of small improvements. It is learning from every miss instead of repeating the same mistake. And that is No-Code AI Platform — the quiet loop that turns flailing into skill.
